summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against every clause of the selected Greek. Neither presents a concrete fidelity defect. They preserve the cleansing purpose, discipline condition, household neglect, saving factors and continuation condition, universal assertions, eternal-life language, unqualified negation, Maximus warning, and prophetic citation. The simplified sentence divisions retain these relationships without adding doctrinal conditions. “Those who return” is contextually defensible, with repentance disclosed as an alternative. The notes are compatible with the supplied project reports and distinguish working readings, conjecture, corrections, gaps, bracketed text, and mediated versional evidence. Acceptance concerns fidelity to this working source and the supplied disclosures; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or editions, establish a unique interpretation, or certify exhaustive collation.
